title: Owl in the Pond
description: A large, dark, round owl-like creature with glowing orange eyes and an angry expression stands waist-deep in a pond, fists raised. It wears a dragonfly on its head and a circular pendant earring while colorful bubbles containing smaller owl icons rise from its head into the night air.
prompt: A large, round, black owl-like creature with glowing orange eyes and an angry expression stands in a pond with fists raised, wearing a dragonfly on its head and a patterned earring. Colorful bubbles containing smaller owl icons float upwards from its head. The scene shows a stone path leading through a garden toward futuristic buildings under a giant orange moon in a dark purple sky, with lily pads and ripples in the water.
